主要内容: Liberty Utilities Co., a regulated utility subsidiary of Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp., has entered into a stock purchase agreement to acquire American Water's regulated operations in New York, known as New York American Water. The acquisition, valued at US$608 million, includes a regulated water and wastewater utility serving over 125,000 customer connections across seven counties in southeastern New York. The transaction is subject to regulatory approval and other typical closing conditions. Liberty Utilities aims to expand its regulated utility business in high-quality jurisdictions, maintaining existing local management and operations teams. The company has committed to maintaining at least existing employment terms for two years following the closing. Customers should not expect any impact on rates as a result of the acquisition. Liberty Utilities is also committed to investing in the water system to improve water quality and customer education on conservation. Liberty Utilities Co. has announced an agreement to acquire American Water's regulated operations in New York, expanding its water utility presence. The transaction is expected to be financed in line with Algonquin's current investment-grade credit profile. The closing of the deal is subject to regulatory approvals, including clearance from the New York Public Service Commission and U.S. antitrust laws. Algonquin's management will provide further insights on the transaction during its Analyst & Investor Days in Toronto and New York in December 2019. CIBC Capital Markets acted as the financial advisor, while Husch Blackwell LLP provided legal counsel. Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. is a diversified international utility with over $11 billion in total assets, serving more than 800,000 connections in the U.S. and Canada. The company is a global leader in renewable energy, with over 2,500 megawatts of net installed capacity and additional projects under construction. The transaction is expected to enhance Algonquin's growth through renewable energy and water infrastructure development. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. (AQN), American Water Works Company, Inc. (AWK).
